role: Seed Selection Board — Pack A Section E Clone Groups

methodology.extraction: Function-constructor parse of MCQ_BANK_A, grouped by QuestionID across dual-block (metadata+content) architecture

models_referenced.DQS: S302-1.0 — 5 dimensions: plausibility(30%), uniqueness(20%), misconception(20%), instructional(20%), discrimination(10%)
models_referenced.EQS: S303-1.0 — 6 dimensions: instructionalValue(25%), reasoningDepth(20%), calculationSupport(15%), standardsIntegration(15%), learningEffectiveness(15%), structure(10%)

selection_criteria: ExplanationCorrect length and quality (ASC/COSO citations, business interpretation)
Distractor quality (ExplanationWrong field length, specificity, misconception targeting)
Structural defect-free status (DL-008, DL-026, DL-016 considerations)
methodology.dual_block_caveat: DL-016 metadata-content offset may cause ExplanationWrong fields in metadata block to describe a different QID's choices. Seed evaluation prioritizes content-block quality (Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect) over metadata-block EW accuracy.

metadata_calibration_notes.systematic_issue: All G1-G5 seeds use Diff=Moderate-Easy(2) and Cog=Understand, but these items test application of COSO principles to specific control scenarios. Recommended recalibration: Cog=Apply for all 5 seeds (consistent with DL-031 finding).
metadata_calibration_notes.pack_a_section_e_pattern: Items 001-035 use Cog=Understand uniformly; Items 045/048/052/053 use Cog=Apply. The rotation clones uniformly use Cog=Understand even when the cognitive demand is Apply-level.
metadata_calibration_notes.recommendation: Recalibrate all 5 seed QIDs to Cog=Apply during the next DL-031 difficulty recalibration pass.

net_certified_impact: P1-E-051 changes from Certified → Archived. P1-E-038, 039, 041, 042, 043 remain Certified. Unique singletons (7 items) remain Certified. Net learner pool impact: -1 Certified item (non-loss — P1-E-043 covers the same topic).

quality_comparison.quality_gap: Seeds vs. clones = 9.5:1 EC length ratio. Clone items provide no pedagogical value beyond what seeds already cover.
